import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem reciprocal_amgm_equality_optimizer :
    ∀ x : ℝ, x > 0 →
      2 - Real.sqrt 2 = 2 - x - 1 / (2 * x) →
      x = Real.sqrt 2 / 2 := by
  intro x hx h
  have h₁ : x > 0 := hx
  have h₂ : 2 - Real.sqrt 2 = 2 - x - 1 / (2 * x) := h
  have h₃ : x = Real.sqrt 2 / 2 := by
    have h₄ : 2 - Real.sqrt 2 = 2 - x - 1 / (2 * x) := h₂
    have h₅ : x ≠ 0 := by linarith
    
    field_simp at h₄
    ring_nf at h₄
    
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 2,
      sq_nonneg (x - Real.sqrt 2 / 2), sq_nonneg (x + Real.sqrt 2 / 2),
      sq_nonneg (x * Real.sqrt 2 - 1), sq_nonneg (x * Real.sqrt 2 + 1)]
  exact h₃

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem reciprocal_amgm_equality_optimizer :
    ∀ x : ℝ, x > 0 →
      2 - Real.sqrt 2 = 2 - x - 1 / (2 * x) →
      x = Real.sqrt 2 / 2 := by
  intro x hx h
  have h₁ : x = Real.sqrt 2 / 2 := by
    have h₂ : 2 - Real.sqrt 2 = 2 - x - 1 / (2 * x) := h
    have h₃ : x > 0 := hx
    have h₄ : 2 - Real.sqrt 2 = 2 - x - 1 / (2 * x) := by linarith
    have h₅ : x = Real.sqrt 2 / 2 := by
      
      have h₆ : x > 0 := h₃
      have h₇ : 2 * x > 0 := by positivity
      field_simp [h₆.ne', h₇.ne'] at h₄ ⊢
      ring_nf at h₄ ⊢
      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2 by norm_num),
        Real.sqrt_nonneg 2,
        sq_nonneg (x - Real.sqrt 2 / 2),
        sq_nonneg (x + Real.sqrt 2 / 2),
        mul_pos h₆ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2))]
    exact h₅
  exact h₁

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem reciprocal_amgm_equality_optimizer :
    ∀ x : ℝ, x > 0 →
      2 - Real.sqrt 2 = 2 - x - 1 / (2 * x) →
      x = Real.sqrt 2 / 2 := by
  intro x hx_pos h
  have h₁ : x = Real.sqrt 2 / 2 := by
    have h₂ : 2 - Real.sqrt 2 = 2 - x - 1 / (2 * x) := h
    have h₃ : x > 0 := hx_pos
    have h₄ : 2 - Real.sqrt 2 = 2 - x - 1 / (2 * x) := by linarith
    have h₅ : x * (2 * x) > 0 := by positivity
    have h₆ : 1 / (2 * x) = 1 / (2 * x) := rfl
    field_simp at h₄ ⊢
    ring_nf at h₄ ⊢
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 2, Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2 by norm_num),
      mul_pos h₃ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)),
      mul_pos h₃ (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) h₃),
      mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) h₃) h₃]
  exact h₁

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem reciprocal_amgm_equality_optimizer :
    ∀ x : ℝ, x > 0 →
      2 - Real.sqrt 2 = 2 - x - 1 / (2 * x) →
      x = Real.sqrt 2 / 2 := by
  intro x hx h
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hx
  have hsq : (Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 = (2 : ℝ) := by
    norm_num
  have hrecip : x + 1 / (2 * x) = Real.sqrt 2 := by
    linarith
  field_simp [hx0] at hrecip
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * x - Real.sqrt 2)]

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem reciprocal_amgm_equality_optimizer :
    ∀ x : ℝ, x > 0 →
      2 - Real.sqrt 2 = 2 - x - 1 / (2 * x) →
      x = Real.sqrt 2 / 2 := by
  intro x hx hEq
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hx
  have hRearranged : Real.sqrt 2 = x + 1 / (2 * x) := by
    linarith
  field_simp [hx0] at hRearranged
  have hsqrt_sq : (Real.sqrt (2 : ℝ)) ^ 2 = 2 := by
    simpa using Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)
  have hzero : 2 * x - Real.sqrt 2 = 0 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * x - Real.sqrt 2)]
  nlinarith
